privacyNote: Simon Says sends the text of the minutes to Claude (Anthropic) to pick out dates, decisions, tasks and where you stand on what you've worked on. Unlike when Simon Says learns your meeting format, the whole text is read. We only store short lines, without names, never the documents. You can remove them at any time.
driveNote: For you to choose folders and see the meetings in them, Simon Says needs read access to your Google Drive. It's only used here: Simon Says shows your folders and the names of the meetings in the folders you choose, opens only the minutes you tick, and stores nothing else from your Drive. The access lasts 24 hours and is then removed automatically; you can also remove it right away.
readFailed: Simon Says couldn't read the documents. Try again.
offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again.
pickTitle: Choose the association's old minutes (at most {max})
pickerFailed: The Google picker couldn't be opened. Try again.
tooMany: Choose at most {max} sets of minutes at a time.
startFailed: The import couldn't be started. Try again.
importedCount: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes imported} other {# sets of minutes imported}}.
failedCount: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes couldn't be read} other {# sets of minutes couldn't be read}}.
startingBatch: Simon Says is opening {count, plural, one {# set of minutes} other {# sets of minutes}} and sending them to Claude in one batch … It takes up to a minute.
estimating: Working out {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} … Nothing is sent yet.
toRead: {count, plural, one {# meeting} other {# meetings}} to import
skipped: {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} skipped
batchNote: This many minutes are sent to Claude in one batch, at half price. Most batches are done within an hour, all within a day. You can close the page meanwhile; the result and the proposed goals wait here.
directNote: Simon Says reads {count} sets of minutes at a time, about half a minute each. Keep the page open until it's done.
cost: Cost for Simon Says: {total} (reading the minutes {imports}{half}, proposing goals over the whole history {digest}). Then Simon Says proposes goals, and you approve them before anyone else sees them.
readN: Import {count, plural, one {# set of minutes} other {# sets of minutes}}
noAccessTitle: Simon Says didn't get read access
noAccessText: That's fine. You can give access later, or choose the minutes one by one in Google's own picker.
googleOdd: Google didn't answer as expected. Try again in a little while.
wrongAccountEmail: Choose the same Google account you're signed in with: {email}.
wrongAccount: Choose the same Google account you're signed in with.
accessRemoved: The read access is removed from Simon Says. Your imported minutes stay.
unverified: Google may show a warning that the app isn't verified. It concerns just this read access, which Google reviews extra carefully.
pickerIntro: Choose the association's old minutes in Google's picker. A document can contain one meeting or several (one per tab or each under its own dated heading). Simon Says reads them in order and proposes which goals you're working towards now, which you've reached and which have petered out.
accessInstead: Give access to the folders instead
missingDates: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes lacks} other {# sets of minutes lack}} a date in the text. Simon Says used the document's creation date, which may be wrong if the document was copied. Change it if needed: the goals rest on the order.

reasons.own_doc: This is one of Simon Says' own meeting documents; that meeting is already included.
reasons.too_long: One of the meetings in the document is too long to be minutes.
reasons.many-meetings: The document seems to contain several meetings — choose one set of minutes per document or split it up.
reasons.too-many: The document contains more than 60 meetings.
reasons.doc_changed: The document has changed since you chose it.
reasons.doc_unreadable: Simon Says can no longer read the document.
reasons.google_auth_lost: The access to Google Drive has expired. Give access again and try once more.
reasons.no_date: No date was found in the minutes.
reasons.refusal: Claude didn't want to read these particular minutes.
reasons.error: Something went wrong while the minutes were read.
reasons.expired: Claude didn't get to it within a day.
reasons.spend: Simon Says can't read minutes right now.
reasons.rate_limited: The association's limit for today is reached.
reasons.stale: The page was closed while it was being read.
reasons.not_creator: Only the admin who started the import can read these documents (it's their read access).
